en.title: NL2AGBench: Benchmarking LLM Auto-Formalization for AlphaGeometry
en.hook: Evaluate how effectively LLMs translate informal math problems into formal geometric languages with this new benchmark.
key_takeaways: Benchmarks LLM-driven auto-formalization specifically tailored for AlphaGeometry
Measures translation accuracy from informal natural language math to formal logic
Provides a standardized evaluation for advanced mathematical reasoning in LLMs
